Question 2
?

Find the equation of the tangent hyperplane to the hypersurface w=ln⁡(x2+y2−z2) at the point (1,−1,1,0).

a
2x+2y−2z−w+2=0
b
2x+2y+2z−w−2=0
c
2x−2y−2z−w−2=0
d
2x−2y−2z+w−2=0
e
2x−2y+2z+w−8=0
